# Zonely

> Zonely is a free, open-source time zone meeting planner and visual world clock for macOS. It helps people compare up to six cities, convert local times, and find considerate meeting hours across time zones.

Canonical website: https://zonely.adikris.in/

## Product facts

- Native macOS menu-bar application for macOS 14 or later.
- Universal download for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
- Compares up to six cities or time zones in one view.
- Finds overlapping working hours for remote and distributed teams.
- Handles UTC offsets and daylight-saving changes using macOS time-zone data.
- Searches by city, airport code, and time-zone abbreviation.
- Works offline with no accounts, analytics, ads, tracking, or network services.
- Free to download and distributed under the MIT License.
